are_you_ok.title: Swimming advisory issued for Lake Norman cove after wastewater spill
are_you_ok.summary: Lincoln County, about 25 miles northwest of Charlotte, NC, issued a swimming advisory for a cove on Lake Norman (the large reservoir just north of the city) after about 2,000 gallons of untreated wastewater leaked into the water.
questions: Have you heard about the swimming advisory on Lake Norman after the wastewater spill?

you_should_know.summary: Charlotte City Council members face a looming deadline to decide on the I-77 South toll lane project — I-77 being the interstate running north-south through Charlotte, NC toward the South Carolina line — and continue discussions regarding regulations for data centers.

you_should_know.title: Duke Energy announces $2.6B in profits as state regulators deliberate on utility’s rate hike request
you_should_know.summary: Duke Energy, the major electric utility serving the Charlotte, NC region, earned $2.6 billion in the first half of the year, up almost 12% from a year ago. Tuesday’s earnings call comes weeks after its Duke Energy Carolinas unit partially backed off its rate-hike request and slashed its return-on-equity demand.
